messages:
michael: Hey — saw my paycheck hit but net is way lower than usual. I had the quarterly bonus + RSU vest this cycle but it looks like an extra ~25% was withheld. I thought UK tax rates apply now that I moved in Jan, but I'm still set up as US on my profile? Can someone check?
sophia - people ops: sorry to hear that. please don't post screenshots with full SSN here. can you DM me your paystub and the last 4? we'll triage with payroll.
michael: dm sent — screenshot and last4 attached. thanks.
maria - payroll: looking now. I see payroll run #PR-20260228-88 flagged both US FED & UK PAYE withheld because country code on the profile is mixed (US mailing + UK tax residency). that can trigger both withholdings on vesting+bonus.
maria - payroll: quick explainer: equity & bonus are treated as supplemental wages and the system applies withholding based on current tax residency tag. we can file an off-cycle correction to refund excess withholding, but tax reclaim/filing may be needed depending on residency docs.
jamie - tax: optional context — if you established UK tax residency before the vesting date, we should've applied PAYE only. if you were still US resident for tax purposes, the US withholding may be correct. if both were applied in error, payroll will reverse excess and finance will issue a corrected P60/P45 equivalent.
michael: timeline? payroll runs weekly and I need cashflow.
maria - payroll: we can kick an off-cycle net-pay correction. ETA 3 business days to process, funds next bank day after approval. i'll open ticket and cc finance.
finance-bot: Ticket #PAY-5829 created by maria - payroll for employee michael. Status: pending-approval. Estimated resolution: 3 business days.
sophia - people ops: i'll coordinate with you and tax. if you haven't, please upload your UK residency docs + updated tax form in Workday (or Gusto) so we don't repeat this.
michael: uploaded residency proof and updated tax form earlier today — maybe I missed the final submit step. double-check?
maria - payroll: got the docs. looks like form status was 'draft' — i pushed it to 'submitted' now. we'll proceed with off-cycle after finance approval.
jamie - tax: FYI if there's a refund from UK PAYE, it's typically handled via HMRC PAYE reconciliation and may require year-end adjustment if we can't reclaim immediately. i'll work with you on reclaim steps if needed.
michael: huge thanks. please keep me posted on the ticket number and expected deposit date.
finance-bot: PAY-5829 updated: approval requested from Finance Manager (sara).
sophia - people ops: tagging @sara (finance) for approval. can we expedite? employee has cashflow needs. :pray:
sara - finance: approved off-cycle. maria please proceed.
maria - payroll: will run off-cycle today. expected deposit tomorrow morning. payroll run id: `OFF-1760459`. you'll get a confirmation DM when processed.
michael: awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround.
sophia - people ops: follow-up — we'll send a short doc on international move checklist (address, residency docs, tax form final submit) to make this smoother for others.
michael: that would be great. thanks everyone!
